description.value: You can take an extra moment when you access your spell cache to gain nearly unlimited access to its contents. When you @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.actions.Item.Download Spell], you can do so as a single action instead of a free action. If you do, you can download any number of spells in your spell cache into any number of your available spell slots, replacing spells on a one-for-one basis and filling spell slots as usual when you Download Spell.
